needsReview.note: The published documents have Arabic and English text only (title_ar/title_en, content_ar/content_en); the other four languages read the English one.
Decision 26: /system-config/public sends numbers only; the sentences are templates in the locale files filled with those numbers, not server text.
They are (auth) screens of Batch 13 and the register screen links to them before sign-in; left untouched. Redirect to /settings/about?tab=legal once the owner confirms the pre-sign-in case.
The old 'copy in 24 hours' and 'transfer to another platform (FHIR)' actions had no handler and no endpoint; hidden. Decide if they are wanted.
The app signs out with POST /auth/logout after DELETE /users/me, only to drop tokens; the reviewer should confirm the server revokes sessions itself.

The old form sent a 1-5 number and an Arabic type; the DTO takes rating positive|neutral|negative and a category. The stars are mapped (4-5 positive, 3 neutral, 1-2 negative); the reviewer should confirm that mapping.
The status text and its colour came from the server in one language; the app shows the text and ignores the colour. A status code would let the app translate it.
POST /support/chat answers { reply } at once (a bot-like reply); there is no agent thread or read state to draw.
The reason is the sentence in the patient's language, stored as sent; a code list would let the hub translate it.
The old '24-48 hours' line is hidden: the returns answer has no expected-time field.
The Account board has the row but no screen or endpoint exists; not drawn.
useGuestGuard.requireAuth shows an alert with Arabic text written in the hook (outside this batch's screens).
aspects is free-form; old reviews hold Arabic sentences as keys, new ones hold codes.
Fields are read under several names (lat/latitude/location.lat, name_ar/name, ...) and the type filter is local; the answer should have one shape.
Owner approved on 2026-10-10 (item 767): a hospital now opens its facility page (/consultations/clinic/[id]). A nurse kind still opens the nursing tab.
